sections.label: Alate
sections.text: Very close to breviarticulatus and difficult to distinguish with certainty; it differs in that the posterior process of the mesonotum is rounded rather than angular, the incisions of the meso- and metanotum are very weak, and the depression around the oval, slightly raised fontanelle is stronger. Compound eyes large and projecting, ocelli relatively large and close to the compound eyes; the basal piece of the clypeus slightly paler than the frons, very short, slightly raised; media with 2—3 branches, cubitus with 7—8 branches. Measurements: body length with wings 13—14 mm, without wings 7.5 mm, fore wing 11 mm.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head brown to blackish brown, the nasus paler; abdomen, thorax and legs yellowish brown, antennae brownish or rusty yellow; only the posterior abdominal tergites with rows of setae. Head pear-shaped, the nasus conical; the frontal outline with a depression. Antennae 14-segmented, segment 3 slightly longer than segment 2, segment 4 much longer than segment 3. Pronotum saddle-shaped, the anterior margin not concave.
